abstract:
The actual interface pTM score (actifpTM) is a modified version of the ipTM score that limits the calculation to only those residues at the interface. Whilst actifpTM provides an effective interface confidence score, a limiting factor is that it makes use of the predicted aligned error (PAE) with probabilities, information that is generated during a ColabFold run, but not output by the package or other model prediction software. The consequent inability to generate actifpTM scores for the results of software such as AlphaFold 2 or AlphaFold 3 has limited its adoption. With reactifpTM we address this problem by providing a standalone tool that can be run on the standard outputs of most model prediction packages.
Using the same underlying principles as actifpTM, reactifpTM has been developed to use standard output files from model prediction software (a model and corresponding PAE) to perform an actifpTM-like calculation.ColabFold models were generated for a dataset of 1078 known interfaces in the PDB. A strong correlation was shown between actifpTM and reactifpTM for this dataset.
reactifpTM is coded in Python. All scripts and associated documentation are available from https://github.com/hlasimpk/reactifptm or https://pypi.org/project/reactifptm.
